18.section: An improved model including glucose and fructose enables the prediction of cell growth at low sucrose concentrations
18.description: The specific growth rate combines glucose, fructose, and nitrate dependence with additive ammonium- and phosphate-dependent contributions to the maximum growth rate.

assumptions.text: The minimum ammonium and phosphate concentrations for growth, represented by δ_A and δ_P, were treated as known and set to 10% of their starting concentrations.
assumptions.quote: They were assumed known in the context of this study to limit the model complexity and avoid overfitting and their values were set to 10% of the starting concentrations.

18.issue: As listed, the terms A/(A+δ_A) and G/(G+K_G) and G/(G+K_{IG}) pair A in g L⁻¹ with δ_A in mM and G in mM with K_G and K_{IG} in g L⁻¹, making the sums dimensionally inconsistent.

19.section: An improved model including glucose and fructose enables the prediction of cell growth at low sucrose concentrations
19.description: The fructose balance adds fructose produced by sucrose hydrolysis and subtracts fructose consumed by active cells, accounting for changes in cultivation volume.
